example_sentences_in_bangla: এই আলমারিটা ঘুণধরা হয়ে গেছে, আর ব্যবহার করা যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: This cupboard is moth-eaten and can't be used anymore.
All the items in his house are worm-eaten.
note: Refers to the common issue of woodworms damaging wooden furniture in traditional Bengali households.
